content.summary: Battery and lighting company Energizer (NYSE:ENR) reported Q3 CY2025 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 3.4% year on year to $832.8 million. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $695.1 million was less impressive, coming in 8.9% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.05 per share was 9.8% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
